investigation: L1 champion no longer completes the level; bisect the native core
conclusion: The pre-2b0a45d state-restore did not reproduce a real boot. reset() is implemented as a state restore, so every training/eval episode after the first used the broken state. The champion is overfit to that bug (frozen hazard counter 0x2B24 + blank HUD font). Cold-boot emulator dynamics are unchanged. The current core is correct: restore == boot, bit-exact.

signature_byte.reading: a counter/RNG driver was left inert by the broken restore, so hazard timing was quieter and more predictable than the real game

rendering.cause: MemorySystem::set_state wiped the monitor ROM, which holds the MO5 character font, so HUD glyphs drew blank from episode 2 onward

rendering.reset_frame: byte-identical between cores; the difference appears on the first HUD repaint
